title: Li-ion Battery Aging Datasets
publisher: NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence / DASHlink
citation: B. Saha and K. Goebel (2007), Battery Data Set, NASA Prognostics Data Repository, NASA Ames Research Center
notes: NASA describes commercially available 18650 cells measured with a voltmeter, ammeter and thermocouple suite at about 10 Hz. The catalog states License not specified and does not state per-sample calibrated sensor uncertainty. The license_url field therefore points back to the source catalog for review, not to a claimed license grant. State of charge is not a direct measurement field in this manifest and must never be invented from cycle index or voltage.
